_readme: Example ratings for the Acme Shop sample.

risks.title: Order export has no staff role check
risks.text: `GET /admin/export` is in the admin controller but has no `@Roles('staff')` decorator, so any signed-in shopper may be able to download the order export (`shop-api:src/modules/admin/admin.controller.ts → exportOrders`). Untested.

risks.title: Abandoned checkouts hold stock for up to a day
risks.text: reserved stock is only released by a nightly job, so an abandoned checkout holds stock for up to a day. Untested.

risks.title: Late webhook can mark a cancelled order paid
risks.text: `markPaid` doesn't check the order is still `PENDING`; a late webhook for a cancelled order would set it back to `PAID`. Untested.

risks.title: Failed fulfilment jobs raise no alert
risks.text: a parked job is only visible in the Redis dashboard; nothing alerts staff, so a paid order can sit unshipped. Untested.

risks.title: No rate limit on sign-in
risks.text: there is no rate limit on `/auth/sign-in`, so passwords can be guessed quickly. Untested.
